dialogue.text: Your highness, the demon lord's army sieges our walls. We can't hold out any longer. It's time to fight. Do you remember everything I taught you?
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: yes Timble, I'm ready.
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: I know you are, but please bear with me majesty. I promised your father you would be fully prepared for when this day happened.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: To defend our kingdom, you will need to field an army, Sire. Start by recruiting some soldiers from the barracks. Make sure you have the required funds, you will need to pay them for their service.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: yes Timble, I know this!
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: Excellent job your highness, PLACEHOLDER will serve you well. Place the recruit onto the battlefield. Let's use this position to start.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Unit position is very important, as it lets units support each other and complete their functions.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Generally, you should consider placing higher-damage higher-range units in your backline, and higher health lower damage and range units in your frontline.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: All units have traits, and getting more units of a certain trait will boost the trait's effect.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Recruiting the same unit multiple times will also strengthen it. Useful to remember as you build your army.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: THEY'RE AT OUR GATES TIMBLE! WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR THIS!
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: very well, send out the army, sire.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: A well fought victory my lord. Wait... what's that?
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Wait...
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: What's that?
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Interesting... It looks like some kind of secret message. Do you think we can read it Timble?
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: The battlefield is pulsing with magic, your majesty. Perhaps that's the key to decode it.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Look Timble, some runes have been revealed by our outcast!!!
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: Excellent observation, Sire. Our Trackers also made us some lenses we might be able to use as well. Let's try using them to reveal another rune.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Fascinating, I've asked the local wizard to reveal the rest of the runes. I wonder if we can use them to read the message.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: Timble...
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: I never learned how to read :(
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: That's ok your majesty, do your best, and make sure to sound the words out.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: No matter, as you battle you may need to evolve your strategy. Press on this unit to review its actions. Click off once you know how they contributed.
dialogue.speaker: Timble

dialogue.text: What is a click, Timble?
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: Are you ready, highness?
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: Yes, are we done now Timble?
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.text: Yes sire, it's time to venture forth and vanquish the demon lord's armies.
dialogue.speaker: You
